chunks: They will come out of the graves with downcast eyes like an expanding swarm of locusts.

key_terms.خُشَّعًا: Humbled, with eyes cast down in submission or awe

ai.seo_question: How are the disbelievers described when they emerge from their graves on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Qamar (54:7) vividly portrays the psychological and physical state of the disbelievers upon resurrection, emphasizing their utter loss of dignity and chaotic haste. The comparison to 'scattered locusts' (jarāḍun muntashir) highlights not only their vast numbers but also their disorganized, aimless movement as they rush toward the Divine reckoning, stripped of their former arrogance.
